text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I did it... I did it, I did it! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's my day off, so I head downtown.
There, I bump into a rather jovial
Rice
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Big Brother! Hehe... Mhm. Today's a
good day!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Big Sister! Hehe... Mhm. Today's a
good day!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I got a ticket for the stage
adaptation of "The Blue Rose
of Good
Fortune."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, that's the picture book
Rice loves.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know how I always end up bringing
misfortune... So usually I
avoid places like
the theater, with lots of people.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... But, you see... Th-this play is special,
because...

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: Meooow!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, a black cat snatches
Rice's ticket from her pocket
and runs
away!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no way! Mr. Kitty, wait up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower gives chase to the black cat,
and I quickly follow behind!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... It went this way!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Slow down there, missy! Sorry, but this
road's blocked off for
construction.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wh-what should I do? Mr. Kitty
definitely went this way!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Well, I could show you the detour... But
that hill's a real killer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sh-show me, please! A hill won't be a
problem... I can run!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, let me know if you get tired,
okay? I can hold your hand!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, let me know if you get tired,
okay? I can hold your hand!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... There you are!

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow! Meow!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, sneaky beaky-like! Come here, Mr.
Kitty, I won't bite—promise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice and I slowly creep up to the cat,
when suddenly, I feel something
under my
foot!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Owie... What's a banana peel doing
here—and two, at that! You okay,
Big
Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Owie... What's a banana peel doing
here—and two, at that! You okay,
Big
Sister?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time we're back on our feet, the cat
is nowhere to be seen. We
didn't even see
which direction it ran off in...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, I'll go ask around and see if
anyone's spotted Mr. Kitty.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, I'll go ask around and see if
anyone's spotted Mr. Kitty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower stands up, musters all her
courage, and begins asking the
people
nearby for info.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-e-excuse me! Have you seen a black cat
around here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice and I keep searching for the black
cat. Some time later, around
sunset, we
finally make a breakthrough!

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Kitty! You still have the ticket in your
mouth... Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... I appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... I appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... I have to give it my all. I want to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So... here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having made up her mind, Rice walks over
to the bush where the cat
is hiding.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Kitty! P-please don't run away—I have
something to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That ticket is very precious to me... S-so I
want you to give it back!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pretty please... Meow!

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The black cat puts down the ticket and
walks away!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mr. Kitty... Thanks so much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's a relief... Big Brother, thanks for
helping out too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's a relief... Big Sister, thanks for
helping out too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mhm... Only because you were with me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mhm... Only because you were with me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When you're by my side, I feel like I can
give it my all—like I can do
anything.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When you're by my side, I feel like I can
give it my all—like I can do
anything.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So, um... Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So, um... Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Please take this ticket!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually... I bought two tickets. You
know, as thanks for always
looking out for
me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually... I bought two tickets. You
know, as thanks for always
looking out for
me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-would you come see this with me? Or is
going with me... just a
bother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You mean it?! Th-thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But as I take the ticket from Rice,
something concerning catches my
eye...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? By today, you mean—aaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're right! We have to hurry then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Rice and I make it to the
theater in the nick of time,
somehow
managing to catch the evening show.
